description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWords utility class, focusing on parsing and sanitization functions related to wake word processing.

classes.name: WakeWordsTest
classes.description: Test suite for WakeWords class methods handling wake word parsing and sanitization.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparatedTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests parsing a comma-separated string into a list, trimming whitespace, and removing empty entries.

methods.name: sanitizeTrimsCapsAndFallsBack
methods.description: Tests sanitization of wake words, including trimming, length capping, and fallback to defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Tests that sanitization enforces the maximum number of wake words.

methods.name: parseIfChangedSkipsWhenUnchanged
methods.description: Verifies that no change is returned if the parsed words match the current list.

methods.name: parseIfChangedReturnsUpdatedList
methods.description: Verifies that an updated list of wake words is returned when changes are detected.
